Overview

Bowling Green is a city in KY with a population of 72,000. Home of Western Kentucky University and the Corvette Museum with a growing manufacturing base. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.9.
